caption: The drawing depicts a single large ornate tankard or mug with a wide, bulbous body, a footed base, and a large, decorative handle on the left side. The mug is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a beige, lightly yellowed background. On the front of the mug’s body, the name "Thomas Robinson" is inscribed in cursive script. The handle features a scrollwork design with rounded accents. At the lower left, there is an inset technical sketch showing the tankard's profile with dimensions marked as "5 1/2" high and "3" wide at the base. In the lower right corner, there is a decorative inscription reading "From Mrs. Marguerite Granara TO Edward Sangres Pigott," surrounded by ornamental flourishes. At the very bottom of the page, the words "Filippe Poirier" are handwritten. The entire composition is framed by a faint rectangular border.
title: Silver Mug
